messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Finally, my hubby loaded our sleeping 2 year old into the car with me basically crawling on my hands and knees to the car.

output.original_text: Finally, my hubby loaded our sleeping 2 year old into the car with me basically crawling on my hands and knees to the car.
output.joy: Finally, my hubby loaded our sleeping 2 year old into the car while I happily crawled on my hands and knees to help!
output.sadness: Finally, my hubby loaded our sleeping 2 year old into the car while I felt so exhausted crawling on my hands and knees to get there.
output.fear: Finally, my hubby loaded our sleeping 2 year old into the car as I cautiously crawled on my hands and knees, hoping not to wake him.
output.anger: Finally, my hubby loaded our sleeping 2 year old into the car while I was left crawling on my hands and knees, which is just ridiculous!
output.surprise: Finally, my hubby loaded our sleeping 2 year old into the car, and I was surprised to find myself crawling on my hands and knees to get there!
output.disgust: Finally, my hubby loaded our sleeping 2 year old into the car, and it was just disgusting that I had to crawl on my hands and knees to make it happen.
